newsitem.title: USA: U.S. wheat weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. wheat weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.

text.p: USDA wheat export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Net sales of 735,100 metric tons (MT) were 24 percent below the week earlier, but 11 percent over the 4-week average.

Major increases reported for Tunisia (100,000 MT), Japan (88,800 MT), Morocco (75,200 MT), Taiwan (66,000 MT), Egypt (61,800 MT), and Israel (58,400 MT) were partially offset by decreases for unknown destinations (59,000 MT) and Malaysia (15,000 MT).

Exports of 505,900 MT--the largest since the marketing year began--were 47 percent above the prior week and 28 percent above the 4-week average. The primary destinations were Egypt (166,200 MT), the Philippines (59,700 MT), Japan (41,200 MT), Israel (35,300 MT), and Germany (31,500 MT).
